title: Evaluating Multilingual and Code-Switched Alignment in LLMs via Synthetic Natural Language Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prompt-based classification accuracy on synthetic, logically controlled Natural Language Inference (NLI) premise-hypothesis pairs translated across six typologically diverse languages (English, Arabic, German, French, Hindi, and Swahili). The evaluation tests for performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages in both monolingual and code-switched (mixed-language) conditions.
